observations: Exact sequence match to UniProt Q4WQM6 from Aspergillus fumigatus; 100% identity and 100% coverage, E-value 3.35e-77.
Annotated as U1 small nuclear ribonucleoprotein C (U1-C), a nuclear spliceosomal protein.
Contains a Matrin-type zinc finger region at residues 4–36; Pfam zf-U1 domain at residues 1–38.
Residues 68–216 are annotated as disordered and strongly proline-biased.
Sequence-derived properties: 216 aa, predicted molecular mass 21.70 kDa, theoretical pI 8.66, GRAVY −0.484, instability index 94.53.

entities.name: UniProt Q4WQM6
observations: Reviewed Aspergillus fumigatus U1 small nuclear ribonucleoprotein C.
Functions in U1 snRNP-mediated recognition of the pre-mRNA 5-prime splice site and early spliceosome assembly.
Annotated localization is nucleus; functions include U1 snRNA binding, pre-mRNA 5-prime splice-site binding, and zinc ion binding.
U1-C is a component of U1 snRNP together with the Sm core proteins and U1-specific proteins U1-70K and U1-A.

entities.name: U1 spliceosomal snRNP
observations: U1-C is a U1 snRNP-specific component involved in 5-prime splice-site recognition and commitment or early spliceosome complex formation.

entities.name: Proline-rich disordered region
observations: The C-terminal portion, approximately residues 68–216, is compositionally biased toward proline and annotated as disordered in the exact reference protein.
Such low-complexity sequence is consistent with a flexible interaction/regulatory region, but individual partner interactions are not established from sequence alone.
